description: Corrected tower from the notes: sigma^2 = xi and sigma^(q^2) = -sigma.
This is the representation required by the compression formulas.
Original optimized tower from the notes: sigma^2 = tau and tau^3 = xi.
Eliminating tau gives sigma^6 = xi. For xi = 9+u and u^2 = -1,
sigma^(q^2) = xi^((q^2-1)/6)*sigma != -sigma, so the formula fails.
towers.xi_expression: (ff.mul sigma sigma sigma sigma sigma sigma)
